title: Everything your SaaS needs.
lede: Real, working features — not templates. Your AI wires them into your product automatically.

items.title: User Accounts
items.text: Login, signup, password reset, social login, and Face ID. Your users get in. You don't build it.

items.title: Payments
items.text: Stripe integration, subscription plans, per-seat billing, and invoice management. You get paid. You don't wire it.

items.title: Teams and Permissions
items.text: Invite coworkers, assign roles, control who sees what. Your customers manage their own teams. You don't code it.

items.title: Notifications
items.text: Email, SMS, and push notifications. Your users stay informed. You don't configure it.

items.title: Security and Compliance
items.text: Audit logs, rate limiting, and SOC 2 readiness. Your app stays secure. You don't worry about it.
